claims.disproof_condition: Downgrade if the DLX OCS line is discontinued or loses to MEMS/robotic alternatives without disclosed wins; upgrade when a hyperscaler is named as customer or shipment volumes appear in Coherent's statutory reporting.
claims.statement: Coherent entered the OCS product market with a liquid-crystal (LCoS/DLX) 300x300-port optical circuit switch demonstrated at OFC 2024, a technology path distinct from Google's MEMS-based Palomar and Lumentum's MEMS OCS — adding a second at-scale merchant OCS supplier candidate to the graph. Limits: vendor self-report demo announcement; no named customer; third-party estimates of 2026 shipment volumes exist but are not ingested.

source_doc.permission_basis: Public press release; URL and short excerpts.
source_doc.title: Coherent — Optical Circuit Switch for Data Centers, live demo at OFC 2024 (DLX liquid-crystal)

sources.quote: the company's field-proven and ultrareliable digital liquid-crystal technology... In an OCS, data signals remain in the optical domain as they transit the switch; eliminating OEO conversion can provide dramatic cost and power consumption savings.
